title: Otori Emu — Group Film Viewing☆〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
We're finally done shooting that film, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We managed to get through the last day in one piece...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which means we can call it a wrap☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A wrap, eh?
A lot really did happen these past few weeks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But looking back, each day we worked on this film ended up being very fulfilling.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. Especially since the initial plan was to participate for one day as extras. I still can't believe they allowed us to join the crew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we sorta ended up working as a part of the crew a lot longer than the cast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but getting to be extras was still an invaluable experience!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After our last performance, I was encouraged to keep the entire story in mind while still maintaining the passion behind my acting, and I was able to apply that this time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we got to watch Bakuno up close as he starred in a feature film for the first time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I learned a lot from everyone too. Seeing how they played their characters, like how they used gestures and facial expressions, taught me a lot...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like this film ended up being a wonderful experience for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You both sound even more enthusiastic than usual!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you got to work as the director's assistant, Rui! How was that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, each day was a challenge because of how unaccustomed I was to that environment. I could only do so much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I was able to learn quite a lot from Mr. Ohara, so I'm glad I was given this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It reminded me of just how deep the directing rabbit hole goes... Hehe. So much so that I'm raring to put on another show now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... You also sound really enthusiastic, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
How about you, Emu?
From what I understand, you spoke quite a lot with everyone on the crew.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I learned lots and lots of things after talking lots and lots with the entire crew!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? What did you talk about with them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uhh...
They told me how many people worked on the film, how they got everything ready for it and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How to actually make films like that from scratch!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How to actually make them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We only got to help shoot this film, but other people put the schedule together, hired crew members, found shoot locations...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, people had already been doing a lot of work on it for years!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For years...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not only that, they said how they still have a lot of work left to do after getting everything on film...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So many different people have to come together to get it onto a screen for people to see!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, what everyone told me reminded me of Keisuke and Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your brothers?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It made me think how hard they have to work to bring shows to guests and put smiles on all their faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I've decided to put in even more effort for the shows we do moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because just like this film, lots and lots of people are working behind the scenes to make those shows happen!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
You're right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm glad to hear that you also had a wonderful experience!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Working on this film taught us all some incredibly valuable lessons.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm super duper glad that we all got to work on this film☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's so great how we get to go to all these different places and learn new things together.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (First, we got to hear about how shows are produced with Shunmeiza. Then, we got to work as part of this film's crew...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's been fun to learn about just how much work goes into making people smile and laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm still not able to do much...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(But I'm gonna keep moving forward.
I'm gonna keep working towards my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And we're gonna keep growing together!)
